DisplayName.Value: Parkify — Pedestrian Path & Park Access Engine

ShortDescription.Value: Enables parks and recreation buildings to function with pedestrian path connections without requiring vehicle roads.

Publish.LongDescription:
⚠️ **BETA / PUBLIC TEST BUILD (v0.1.0)**
*Parkify is an experimental pedestrian access engine for city parks and venues.*
---
**Build true pedestrian-first parks.** Parkify allows parks, recreation areas, and leisure venues connected to pedestrian walkways to operate without triggering "No Road Access" notifications while maintaining full visitor routing and service vehicle access.
### Key Features - **Pedestrian Park Access**: Parks connected to footpaths and pedestrian lanes operate normally. - **Service Integration**: Maintains underlying service delivery and emergency routing bridges. - **Real-Time Park Monitoring**: Status dashboard showing all active pedestrian-accessible parks. - **Native CS2 UI Integration**: Top-left toolbar button with green nature theme.
Publish.ChangeLog: ### 0.1.0 BETA — Initial Public Test Release - Pedestrian lane and park connection recognition. - Automatic road connection bridging for pedestrian paths. - Active status panel and toggle controls.
